levelRule: Level-based games need at least 20 authored levels with level select through env.progress.

records.hashCheck: The reviewer recorded all six hashes at the start and the end of each round; both rounds' records were identical, and the served modules matched in Chrome.
records.verdictNote: Round 2 was first reported as REJECT on a depth-4 look-ahead bot, which lies outside the agreed bar (depth 2 and 3); the reviewer then approved on the agreed bars and recorded depth 4 as a note.

findings.observation: A no-prompt look-ahead bot with free restarts (depth 3) won boards 16-18, 21, 24 and 26, about 15 boards in all. Boards were regenerated as denser, low-nullity scrambles with a look-ahead filter and tighter budgets (slack 1 on boards 7-26); depth 2 (40 seeds) and depth 3 (30 seeds) now win nothing from board 3, and a quality test ports the bot.
An unsolved board with no presses left ended the run after 1.2 s, too short to reach Undo by touch. An 8 s countdown is now shown on the canvas; an undo cancels it and idle still loses.
Board definitions, meta and shape-name arrays were mutable and the advice line returned shared arrays. They are now frozen or copied.
With the cursor on a hole, the shape card showed a neighbouring tile's shape. It now reads 'no tile'.
Board 17's tip could be read as wrap-around, and the first row and column tiles on board 19 had no tip. Both tips were rewritten; an unused constant was removed.

openNotes: An exhaustive depth-4 look-ahead with free restarts (on the order of 10^5 to 10^6 sequences per decision) beats boards 3, 4, 7, 16, 20, 22, 23, 24 and 25 in small samples (for example 11 of 16 on board 22 and 6 of 16 on board 25). Human-plausible bots, the hill-climber with restarts and informed random presses, win nothing from board 12.
Optimal press counts rise from 1 to 14; bot success does not rise monotonically across the late boards.
Boards 7-26 allow one spare press. Undo refunds a press and the prompt asks for it at once, so a player who follows the prompt is never trapped.
tests/phase-tiles.test.js is over 1,500 lines; tests are exempt from the 800-line guideline.
Text fit was checked with a width model, not measured fonts.
